spec: .rotini.spec.yaml:36:11: command demo/deploy: flag "quota": identifier "-q" is also flag "quiet" on command demo, which cascades; after "deploy" it means this flag instead, so flag "quiet" can't be given there at all, only before "deploy". Use another identifier for --quota
spec: .rotini.spec.yaml:59:11: command demo/show: flag "help": identifiers "-h", "--help" are also flag "help" on command demo, which short-circuits; after "show" they mean this flag instead, so flag "help" can't be given there at all, only before "show". Declare it as a bool to redeclare the same switch, or rename it
